{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", sample_seq_counts.max())

# Identify patients with multiple sample_seq
multiple_samples = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple samples:", len(multiple_samples))

# Keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final count of enrolled patients
enrolled_patients = len(df_clean)
print("Enrolled patients (after deduplication):", enrolled_patients)"}
